title: Changelog Change Categories
description: Canonical release-note categories and aliases used by NEXT F Changelog records.

categories.label: Added
categories.description: New backward-compatible capability, contract, tooling or documentation introduced by the release.

categories.label: Changed
categories.description: Existing behavior, metadata or implementation intentionally changed.

categories.label: Fixed
categories.description: A defect or inconsistency was corrected.

categories.label: Security
categories.description: Security, privacy or abuse-resistance change requiring explicit visibility.

categories.label: Deprecated
categories.description: A still-supported item should not be used for new implementations.

categories.label: Removed
categories.description: A previously available item is no longer present in the active release.

categories.label: Breaking
categories.description: Known incompatibility requiring an explicit major-version/migration review.

categories.label: Integrity
categories.description: Registry consistency, validation, evidence, safety or boundary protection.

categories.label: Preserved
categories.description: Explicitly confirms an architectural or compatibility boundary was intentionally preserved.

categories.label: Internal
categories.description: Internal implementation/maintenance detail with no declared external semantic impact.
